name: cue-plugin-registry
docs: Backed by assistant/src/plugins/registry/ (types/registry-file/indexer/search/embedding-seed). This file is the curated, commit-pinned, security-reviewed allowlist that backs `cue plugins search/reindex/versions/publish` and the HTTP browse/search/detail surface. `sources` are the GitHub repos the indexer crawls for plugin manifests (a package.json declaring an @vellumai/plugin-api peerDependency); `plugins` are the reviewed, pinned entries surfaced by default. Every `plugins` entry is pinned to the SAME full commit SHA the upstream `plugins/marketplace.json` install-resolution manifest carries, so anything browsable here is installable. Repos that are installable upstream but NOT listed here were deliberately left out of the browse catalog — they stay reachable from the CLI. Community repos are added post-alpha via PR (see `cue plugins publish`).

reviewStatuses.curated: Cue authored the plugin, forked/adopted it, or maintains the in-repo adapter that makes it run on Cue — plus a pinned commit. This is an ownership claim, so it is only used where Cue actually carries code for the entry.
reviewStatuses.community: Third-party plugin. License + manifest verified and pinned to a commit by the Cue team, but Cue neither authored nor maintains it — surfaced with a third-party notice.
reviewStatuses.unreviewed: Indexed from an allowlisted source but not yet hand-reviewed; never surfaced over HTTP, only shown when --allow-unreviewed is passed on the CLI.

sources.label: model-router — excluded: its pre-model-call hook overrides model selection and collides with Cue's per-call-site routing (llm.callSites.*)
dynamic-notch — excluded: ships a competing macOS chat/voice client alongside Cue's own desktop app and Cue Live
simple-memory — excluded: an authoring reference that replaces the memory defaults with low-cost variants
cofounder — excluded: duplicates Cue's own memory, agents, and decision tracking
